column1: # Avatar and channel-badge goldens, shared by the iOS and Android tests.
# Generated once from the Swift rules in apps/ios/UMSH/DesignSystem/AvatarStyle.swift
# and PeerAvatarShape.swift; hint text rendered by the core's render_node_hint.
# kind: peer (fill = the hint's bytes) or channel (fill = the badge band of the tint).
# role: wire role code; caps: capability bits in hex, or - when nothing was advertised.
# text: the lettering color by APCA (peer) or by band (channel).
# hint: the core's render_node_hint text for the bytes (peer only), drawn two over two.
